title: Rhea D Probable NDE 3165
content: I was on the table in the doctor's office face down, I felt like I was just falling asleep. Next thing I know, I was floating in the top of the room looking down on myself, my mom in the corner on a stool with silver legs. She was hiding her face in her hands because she didn't want to see them cut me. I saw two doctors leaning over me on the table. In an instant, I was in a tunnel with a bright light at the end. I distinctively remember that I wasn't moving my feet and wondering how I could be advancing through the tunnel. When I got to the end of the tunnel there was a man in an all-white tunic awaiting me. He never had to speak physically, but I could hear him and he could hear me. He took me by the hand and we walked. I knew him although I had never seen him. He loved me, I loved him and I felt safe with him. This place that we walked was the most beautiful place that I have ever see. It was like a grassy, hilly place filled with flowers. The colors were so bright and vivid. It makes the greenest grass here on Earth look dirty. Like Hawaii but the colors were so bright they look like wet paint. After our short walk, he stopped and asked me if I wanted to go back with my mother and brother, or did I want to stay. At that second, I thought of my mom and brother for the first time. I told him (without speaking) that I needed to go back with them. He smiled at me, and in the next second, I was back on the table in the doctor's office. The feeling was horrible afterward for a few seconds because you have to get adjusted to your fleshy body. I felt like I had on a mud suit, kind of like the feeling you get when you climb out the side of a pool soaking wet. You feel like you weigh a ton and can feel the gravity pull on you. It took just a few seconds and I felt normal. It was hard trying to describe to my mother what had happened. As far as she knew, nothing happened. I kept trying to tell her 'I saw a man,' she didn't understand. I kept trying to tell her for years. I finally was able to explain it in more detail when I got about seven or eight. She was the only one that knew of my experience for years. She believed me because I told her what happened in the room when she thought that I was 'asleep' and facing the opposite of her. I saw what she was doing when I was floating before I went to heaven. She said that they ended up stopping the surgery abruptly without giving an explanation except it was too close to my spine. I know that they made some mistake along the way, maybe cutting something already and they knew I was on my way out. I have shared only with people closest to me. A child cannot imagine what they don't know. I had never heard of a NDE. I never knew of angels or my now savior Jesus Christ at that time. I was not under the influence of anything. They only used topical anesthesia that we knew of.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: She noted she was advancing through the tunnel without moving her feet.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man in an all-white tunic awaiting her at the end of the tunnel; communicated without physical speech; took her by the hand and walked with her.

environment.environment_other_detail: Grassy, hilly place filled with flowers; colors extremely bright and vivid, compared to Hawaii and 'wet paint'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Procedure in a doctor's office; topical anesthesia; surgery reportedly stopped abruptly because it was too close to her spine.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fell asleep/OBE (ceiling view of room) → instant transition to tunnel with bright light → met a man in white and walked in a beautiful landscape → asked to choose to return or stay → instant return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She specifically wondered how she could be moving through the tunnel without moving her feet.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The feeling was horrible afterward for a few seconds because you have to get adjusted to your fleshy body. I felt like I had on a mud suit.”
